chunks: "The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم fell from a horse, and the right side of his body was injured, so he led them in salat (prayer) while seated in the room of Umm Ibrahim."

key_terms.النَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.شِقُّهُ الْأَيْمَنُ: the right side of his body
key_terms.فَرَسٍ: a horse from which he fell
key_terms.فَصَلَّى: he performed salat (prayer) / led in prayer

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم ever lead the people in salat (prayer) while seated due to injury?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم was injured after falling from a horse and then led the people in salat (prayer) while seated. It highlights a historical incident connected to congregational prayer and indicates the occurrence of seated leadership in prayer due to physical injury.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1119 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The Prophet (sw) once fell from a horse, injuring the right side of his body, and he led the people in prayer while seated in the room of Umm Ibrahim”.
